## Opening

### `intro` — *printed once, before the first room*

You wake on the deck of the SS Wayfarer, a small freighter drifting dead in space. Emergency lighting bathes everything in dim red. Main power is offline, life support is on reserve, and the ship is silent. Restore power and get off this ship.

### `win_epilogue` — *fallback last words for a win*

You strap in and pull the launch lever. Clamps release with a thud, and the pod kicks free of the Wayfarer. Through the porthole, the dark freighter shrinks against the stars. You made it.

## Room — Crew Quarters

### `rooms.crew_quarters.description` — *what you see on arriving*

Narrow bunks line the walls of the cramped crew quarters. Red emergency light pulses from a strip above the hatch. A corridor lies to the east.

### `rooms.crew_quarters.alt_description` — *instead, once power_restored is set*

The crew quarters are brightly lit again. Your bunk looks almost inviting. A corridor lies to the east.

### `rooms.crew_quarters.sounds` — *the answer to `listen`*

Nothing but your own breathing and the tick of cooling metal somewhere behind the bulkhead.

### `rooms.crew_quarters.alt_sounds` — *instead, once power_restored is set*

The air recyclers hum, and somewhere aft a pump cycles on and off.

## Room — Main Corridor

### `rooms.corridor.description` — *what you see on arriving*

The main corridor runs the length of the ship. In the red emergency glow you can make out a status console set into the wall. The crew quarters are west, the cargo bay east, the engine room south. To the north, a heavy door leads to the escape pod bay.

### `rooms.corridor.alt_description` — *instead, once power_restored is set*

White light floods the corridor and the air recyclers hum steadily. The crew quarters are west, the cargo bay east, the engine room south, and the escape pod bay door is north.

### `rooms.corridor.sounds` — *the answer to `listen`*

The corridor is dead quiet. Every sound you make goes the whole length of it and comes back.

### `rooms.corridor.alt_sounds` — *instead, once power_restored is set*

Fans, the steady hum of restored power, and the corridor lights ticking as they warm.

### `rooms.corridor.exits.north.pass_message` — *going north, to the Escape Pod Bay*

You step over the sill into the pod bay. The air in here is colder, and very still.

## Room — Cargo Bay

### `rooms.cargo_bay.description` — *what you see on arriving*

Cargo netting and strapped-down containers fill the bay. A squat maintenance droid stands motionless near a large supply crate.

### `rooms.cargo_bay.sounds` — *the answer to `listen`*

Cargo netting shifts very slightly against the containers. Nothing else.

### `rooms.cargo_bay.alt_sounds` — *instead, once power_restored is set*

Air moving through the bay, and the netting creaking gently against the containers.

## Room — Engine Room

### `rooms.engine_room.description` — *what you see on arriving*

The engine room is dead quiet. The reactor housing looms cold and dark. A rack of tools hangs by the hatch.

### `rooms.engine_room.sounds` — *the answer to `listen`*

Silence, which is the wrong sound for an engine room, and the loudest thing in the ship.

### `rooms.engine_room.alt_sounds` — *instead, once power_restored is set*

The reactor housing stays cold and silent, but the room around it has come back to life: fans, relays, the whole ship's business.

## Room — Escape Pod Bay

### `rooms.escape_pod_bay.description` — *what you see on arriving*

A single escape pod sits in its launch cradle, hatch open. A launch lever juts from the console beside it.

### `rooms.escape_pod_bay.sounds` — *the answer to `listen`*

The pod's hull ticks as it sits in the cradle. Beyond it, nothing at all — that side is hull, and then vacuum.

### `rooms.escape_pod_bay.alt_sounds` — *instead, once power_restored is set*

The pod's systems murmur to themselves in the cradle, waiting.

### `rooms.escape_pod_bay.exits.south.pass_message` — *going south, to the Main Corridor*

You duck back out into the corridor.

## Door — pod bay door

### `doors.pod_door.description` — *on examining it*

A heavy pressure door with magnetic seals, marked ESCAPE POD BAY.

### `doors.pod_door.locked_message` — *when it will not open*

You haul on the pod bay door, but its magnetic seals hold fast. Without main power, it won't budge.

### `doors.pod_door.open_message` — *when it opens*

The lock plate goes green and the pod bay door grinds back into its housing, stiff from however long it has been sitting shut in the cold.

## Item — emergency manual

### `items.emergency_manual.description` — *on examining it*

SS WAYFARER EMERGENCY PROCEDURES. Section 4: In case of main power failure, the maintenance droid R-6 can reroute auxiliary power. R-6 requires a charged power cell. Spare cells are stored in the cargo bay supply crate.

## Item — status console

### `items.status_console.description` — *on examining it*

MAIN POWER: OFFLINE. LIFE SUPPORT: RESERVE. ESCAPE POD: SEALED.

### `items.status_console.alt_description` — *instead, once power_restored is set*

MAIN POWER: ONLINE. LIFE SUPPORT: NOMINAL. ESCAPE POD: READY.

## Item — prybar

### `items.prybar.description` — *on examining it*

A meter of solid steel with a flattened end. Good for opening things that don't want to open.

## Item — reactor

### `items.reactor.description` — *on examining it*

The main reactor is cold. Its primary cells are slagged — this thing isn't restarting without a full service dock. Auxiliary power routing would be a job for the maintenance droid.

## Item — supply crate

### `items.supply_crate.description` — *on examining it*

A sealed cargo crate stenciled SPARES — POWER CELLS. The lid is jammed shut.

### `items.supply_crate.alt_description` — *instead, once crate_open is set*

The crate stands open, packing foam scattered around it.

### `items.supply_crate.open_refusal` — *on trying to open it*

You work your fingers under the lid and heave. It does not give — the crate is banded shut and jammed hard. Bare hands are not going to do it; something with leverage might.

## Item — power cell

### `items.power_cell.description` — *on examining it*

A sealed energy cell, humming faintly and glowing pale blue along its charge strips.

## Item — launch lever

### `items.launch_lever.description` — *on examining it*

A heavy manual release lever. Pull it and the pod launches — no countdown, no second chances.

## Item — escape pod

### `items.escape_pod.description` — *on examining it*

A one-person pod, cramped but flight-ready. The launch lever beside it fires the release.

## Character — maintenance droid

### `npcs.maintenance_droid.description` — *on examining them*

A squat utility droid, model R-6. Its chest port — sized for a standard power cell — is empty, and its optics are dark.

### `npcs.maintenance_droid.dialogue[0].text` — *talking: when droid_active is false*

The droid is dark and unresponsive. An empty power socket gapes in its chest.

### `npcs.maintenance_droid.dialogue[1].text` — *talking: first time only, when droid_active is true, when power_restored is false*

R-6 boots with a rising whir. 'Unit R-6 online. Diagnostic: main reactor offline. Rerouting auxiliary power… done. Main power restored, Captain. The escape pod bay is now accessible.'

### `npcs.maintenance_droid.dialogue[2].text` — *talking: when droid_active is true, when power_restored is true*

R-6 beeps politely. 'Recommend immediate evacuation via escape pod, Captain.'

## Interactions

### `interactions[pry_crate].message` — *use prybar on supply_crate*

You wedge the prybar under the crate lid and heave. The lid pops off, revealing a power cell glowing softly in its packing foam.

### `interactions[power_droid].message` — *use power_cell on maintenance_droid*

You slot the power cell into the droid's chest port. It clicks home, and lights flicker up across the droid's chassis.

### `interactions[pull_lever].message` — *use launch_lever*

You grip the launch lever.

### `interactions[try_reactor].message` — *use reactor*

You work through the cold-start sequence from memory. Nothing answers: no hum, no warmth, not even a fault light on the housing. The primary cells really are slagged. Whatever gets you off this ship, it will not be this.

### `interactions[use_escape_pod].message` — *use escape_pod*

If you want to use the escape pod, you'll need to go into it.
